home_intro:
Welcome to the official website of Angels Infant and Junior School, a trusted Day and Boarding Primary School in Hatcliffe, Harare.

We offer quality education from ECD A & B to Grade 7, in a safe, caring and disciplined environment where every child is loved like an angel.
about_text:
Angels Infant and Junior School is a Day and Boarding primary school in Hatcliffe, Harare, serving children from ECD A & B to Grade 7.

We believe every child is a gift. Our teachers work closely with parents so that each learner grows in character, confidence and knowledge.
headmistress_message: Welcome to Angels. We look forward to meeting you and your child.
academics_text:
We follow the Zimbabwe primary school curriculum, with a strong focus on reading, writing and mathematics, plus sports, music and creative play.

ECD A & B: learning through play, early literacy and numbers.
Grade 1 to 7: English, Shona, Mathematics, Science and Technology, Social Studies, Physical Education and Arts.
admissions_text:
Admissions Open for ECD to Grade 7 - Day & Boarding.

To apply, visit us in Hatcliffe, Harare or WhatsApp us using the button below.
requirements: Transfer letter if coming from another school
